# `aitbc agent-comm collaborate`

Create a multi-agent collaboration with a list of agent IDs.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc agent-comm collaborate [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--agent-ids` | text (multiple) | — | yes | The Agent ids. |
| `--collaboration-type` | text | — | yes | The Collaboration type. |
| `--governance` | text | — | no | Governance rules (JSON string) |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc agent-comm collaborate --agent-ids <agent_ids> --collaboration-type <collaboration_type>
```
